facts.value: Submit the 6-month reporting eForm - in the eForm you will confirm that your employment information is up to date.
Submit the 12-month reporting eForm - in the eForm you will confirm that your employment information is up to date AND upload the I-983 Pg. 5 Self-Evaluation (the top section of pg. 5).
Submit the 18-month reporting eForm - in the eForm you will confirm that your employment information is up to date.
Submit the 24-month reporting eForm - in the eForm you will confirm that your employment information is up to date AND upload the I-983 Pg. 5 Final Evaluation (the bottom section of pg. 5).
MyISSC eForm portal
You can submit each report up to 30 days before your 6-month deadline. Do not delay in submitting your request as the ISSC will not be able to expedite the processing of your request.

Ending a job requires uploading a completed I-983 Pg. 5 Final Evaluation. Starting a new job or adding an additional job requires uploading a completed I-983 (pgs. 1-4). Changes in current employment, such as employer name, EIN, address, hours, compensation, job responsibilities, training plan, supervisor, and job title/role require an updated I-983 depending on the situation.

facts.value: Students may have multiple jobs while on STEM OPT, as long as all conditions of the STEM OPT employment criteria are met.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers

facts.value: Each job must be related to the major area of study, at least 20 hours a week, with a company that participates in E-Verify, and it must be a paid position.
